changeSet.author: szonyim
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE message_fts USING fts5( message_id, content, properties, tokenize = 'trigram', content = 'message', content_rowid = 'rowid' )

changeSet.author: szonyim
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER message_ai AFTER INSERT ON message BEGIN INSERT INTO message_fts(rowid, message_id, content, properties) VALUES (new.rowid, new.message_id, new.content, new.properties); END

changeSet.author: szonyim
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER message_ad AFTER DELETE ON message BEGIN INSERT INTO message_fts(message_fts, rowid, message_id, content, properties) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.message_id, old.content, old.properties); END
